lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- Asking for Help Without Apologising
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Isabel Ladeia Tavares | Lesson 9 -- Asking for Help Without Apologising
lesson.grammar_point: indirect questions: could you tell me, do you know if, I was wondering whether
phases: The Question You Did Not Ask

listenings.text: When I started my PhD, I apologized before every single question. Sorry to bother you. Sorry, this is probably a stupid question. Sorry, I know you are busy. One afternoon my supervisor stopped me and counted. In one question I had said sorry three times, and the question itself was eight words long. She told me something that I still pass on to every new student. An apology at the start of a question tells the other person that you think you are wasting their time, and after a while they start to believe it. A clear question tells them that you have done your part. So now I teach a simple rule. Before you ask, spend fifteen minutes trying to figure it out yourself. Then ask, and ask precisely. Not, I do not understand step four. Instead, could you tell me whether step four is done on ice? I checked the protocol and last year's notes, and they say different things. That sentence takes ten seconds, it shows what you have already tried, and it is very easy to answer. Nobody in a lab has ever been annoyed by a question like that. What annoys people is the mistake that happens because somebody was too embarrassed to ask.

Hi, this is Paulo, the lab manager, and this message is for the new interns who start on Monday. Three things before you arrive. First, nobody expects you to know where anything is kept. If you cannot find something, ask, but ask the right person. Questions about the equipment come to me. Questions about your project go to your supervisor. Second, when you ask, tell me what you have already tried. If you say, do you know where the buffers are, I will point at a shelf. If you say, could you tell me which buffer the protocol means in step two, because there are three on the shelf with very similar names, then I can actually help you. Third, the plate reader freezes about once a week. There is a simple workaround, and it is written on a card next to the machine, so please read the card before you restart anything. My door is open every morning until eleven. After that, send me a message and I will get back to you the same day.
